category_mapping.debt_interest: 债务付息支出 (debt interest payments). This is the interest-only line (class 232), distinct from 债务还本支出 (principal repayment, class 231) which is NOT included. 2025 = 13,491亿元 from MOF data (4.7% of total, cross-checked). 2024 = 12,872.9亿元 DERIVED as 13,491 ÷ 1.048 (using the published 2025 YoY growth of +4.8%); not from a primary 2024 source — see notes.
category_mapping.defense: 国防支出. National ≈ central-level (local defense spending negligible). 2025 uses the announced budget figure (final 决算 not yet published); 2024 uses the final 决算. Flagged per-year.
category_mapping.economic_affairs: 科学技术支出 (science & technology — R&D; placed here per task instruction) + 交通运输支出 (transport). NOTE: 农林水支出 (agriculture/forestry/water), 资源勘探工业信息等支出, 商业服务业等支出, and 粮油物资储备支出 are published by MOF but were not separately sourced for 2024–2025; they fall in 'other' for these years. This understates economic_affairs vs. the full MOF functional scope — documented, not hidden.
category_mapping.education: 教育支出. Cross-checked against Ministry of Education annual funding announcements (which report the functional 教育支出 as % of national total).
category_mapping.general_admin: 一般公共服务支出. NOT published in the national MOF monthly functional releases used here → null; folded into 'other' residual. Documented.
category_mapping.health: 卫生健康支出. Rename history: 医疗卫生支出 (2007–2010) → 医疗卫生与计划生育支出 (2011–2018) → 卫生健康支出 (2019+).
category_mapping.other: Residual (total minus separately-reported areas). For FY2025 comprises: 城乡社区支出, 农林水支出, 一般公共服务支出, 公共安全支出, 文化旅游体育与传媒支出 (3,946亿元), 节能环保支出 (5,816亿元), 外交支出, 住房保障支出, 资源勘探工业信息等支出, 商业服务业等支出, 粮油物资储备支出, 灾害防治及应急管理支出, 自然资源海洋气象等支出, 援助其他地区支出, 金融支出, 预备费, 其他支出, 债务发行费用支出. Culture and environment are identified within the residual for FY2025 (values above) but kept in 'other' per the 9-area schema.
category_mapping.public_order: 公共安全支出. NOT published in the national MOF monthly functional releases used here → null; folded into 'other' residual. Documented.
category_mapping.social_protection: 社会保障和就业支出 (social security & employment).

fiscal_year_note: Calendar-year basis; fiscal_year 'FY2025' = calendar 2025. Uses NATIONAL general public budget expenditure (全国一般公共预算支出 = central + local combined), the standard auditable series published by the Ministry of Finance. The central-government-only series does not publish a functional breakdown, so the national series is used throughout. Totals are 决算 (final accounts) where available; 2025 total is the MOF full-year release figure.
notes: SCOPE: This sample covers FY2024–FY2025. FY2006–FY2023 were not compiled (see sources[] gaps). FY2024 is partial: only total, education, defense, and debt-interest (derived) are available; pct shares sum to ~25%, NOT 100 — this is a documented deviation, not an error. FY2025 sums to 100.1% (within ±1.5). Defense 2025 is a budget figure (final not published); all other 2025 items are full-year actuals. 2006 excluded from any future extension: pre-2007 支出功能分类 reform makes it non-comparable; MOF monthly functional series starts Jan 2007.
period: FY2024–FY2025 (as available — see sources[] for coverage gaps; FY2006–FY2023 not compiled in this sample)
sources: Ministry of Finance (MOF) monthly fiscal releases via Xinhua: 2025 full-year national general public budget expenditure 287,395亿元 with functional items (education 43,417; science & technology 12,062; culture/tourism/sports/media 3,946; social security & employment 44,416; health 21,446; energy conservation & environment 5,816), published 2026-01-30, accessed Oct 2026.
MOF 2025 fiscal data via 国新证券 research report (2025年财政收支数据解读, PDF): transport expenditure 11,977亿元 (down 0.7%), accessed Oct 2026.

MOF 2025 debt interest via 土地财政 analysis citing MOF data: 债务付息支出 13,491亿元 (up 4.8%), accessed Oct 2026. Cross-check: 朱青/中国税务报 2026-03-11 confirms 2025 interest = 4.7% of total expenditure, growth 4.8%.

Ministry of Education / NBS / MOF annual education funding announcements: 2024 national education expenditure (教育支出) 41,495.09亿元 = 14.58% of national total 284,605.57亿元 (决算); 2019 education 34,648.57亿元 = 14.51% of 238,858.37亿元, accessed Oct 2026.

National defense budgets: 2025 national defense budget 17,846.65亿元 (up 7.2%, announced Mar 2025); 2024 national defense final (决算) 16,652.08亿元 (100% of budget, via 2024 central final accounts); 2022 central defense final 14,499.63亿元 (via NPC budget execution report). National ≈ central for defense (local defense negligible; e.g., 2026 national 1.94万亿 vs central 1.91万亿).
FX: fx_lcu_per_usd_annual_avg from ~/workspace/countries/data/profiles/China-profile.json (ECB via Frankfurter annual average): 2024 = 7.1956, 2025 = 7.1874 CNY/USD.

COVERAGE GAPS (honest): FY2006–FY2023 functional breakdowns were not compiled for this sample. The MOF publishes monthly functional items (Jan 2007 onward) and the NBS China Statistical Yearbook carries historical functional tables; a full 2007–2023 series is feasible for future extension but was not assembled here. FY2024 is partial (total, education, defense, debt-interest only); health, social protection, science, culture, environment, transport, agriculture/water, and urban-community items for 2024 were not located in accessible sources.
unit: percent of total national general public budget expenditure; USD billions
